info.name: RideLink
info.description: Final RideLink university demo collection. Run folders in numeric order with the RideLink Local environment. Register PASSENGER generates a fresh unique data set and clears captured runtime values.

item.name: 00 - Health / Documentation
item.description: Public OpenAPI documents for all four services.

exec: pm.test("OpenAPI document is returned", function () { pm.expect(json.openapi).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(json.info).to.be.an("object"); });

item.name: 01 - Account Setup
item.description: Creates unique PASSENGER and DRIVER accounts, then captures Account-owned IDs and JWTs.

exec: if (!password) { throw new Error("Set testPassword in the selected RideLink Local environment before running setup."); }
pm.test("Passenger login identity matches registration", function () { pm.expect(json.userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("passengerId")); pm.expect(json.role).to.eql("PASSENGER"); });
pm.test("Driver login identity matches registration", function () { pm.expect(json.userId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("driverAccountId")); pm.expect(json.role).to.eql("DRIVER"); });

item.name: 02 - Driver Setup
item.description: Creates the Driver-owned operational profile and vehicle, then makes the driver eligible for assignment.

exec: pm.test("Driver profile references Account user", function () { pm.expect(json.accountId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("driverAccountId")); });
pm.test("Vehicle ID exists and belongs to driver", function () { pm.expect(json.vehicleId).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(json.driverId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("driverId")); });
pm.test("Response is an array", function () { pm.expect(json).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Created driver is available", function () { pm.expect(json.some(function (d) { return d.driverId === pm.environment.get("driverId"); })).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 03 - Ride Happy Path
item.description: Runs the contracted REQUESTED → ASSIGNED → ACCEPTED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED lifecycle.

exec: pm.test("Final fare fields are null", function () { pm.expect(json.finalFare).to.eql(null); pm.expect(json.finalFareId).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Authoritative final fare ID exists", function () { pm.expect(json.finalFareId).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

item.name: 04 - Payment Happy Path
item.description: Pays the completed happy-path ride using Ride.finalFareId and Ride.finalFare.

exec: pm.test("Payment references authoritative IDs and amount", function () { pm.expect(json.rideId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("rideId")); pm.expect(json.fareId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("finalFareId")); pm.expect(json.amount).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get("finalFare"))); });
pm.test("Receipt matches payment and ride", function () { pm.expect(json.receiptId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("paymentId")); pm.expect(json.rideId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("rideId")); });
pm.test("Receipt is PAID with correct total", function () { pm.expect(json.paymentStatus).to.eql("PAID"); pm.expect(json.totalFare).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get("finalFare"))); });

item.name: 05 - Negative Security
item.description: Security failures use read-only or rejected operations and preserve happy-path variables.

item.name: Protected Ride Endpoint With Malformed JWT

exec: pm.test("Forbidden update caused no mutation", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().availability).to.eql("AVAILABLE"); });
pm.test("Forbidden lifecycle call caused no mutation", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); });

item.name: 06 - Negative Ride
item.description: Uses dedicated rides so invalid transitions and no-driver checks do not alter the completed happy-path ride.

exec: pm.test("Error code is CONFLICT", function () { pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("CONFLICT"); });
pm.test("Invalid transition caused no mutation", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("ASSIGNED"); });

request.description: Uses a generated service area that has no configured driver.

exec: pm.test("No-driver ride begins REQUESTED", function () { pm.expect(json.status).to.eql("REQUESTED"); pm.expect(json.driverId).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Assignment failure caused no mutation", function () { pm.expect(json.status).to.eql("REQUESTED"); pm.expect(json.driverId).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Invalid location caused no mutation", function () { pm.expect(json.latitude).to.eql(6.9271); pm.expect(json.longitude).to.eql(79.8612); });

item.name: 08 - Negative Account
item.description: Account authentication, duplicate, and missing-resource behavior.

exec: pm.test("Error code is CONFLICT", function () { pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("CONFLICT"); });

request.description: Manual conditional request. Account ownership rules require an ADMIN JWT to reach the nonexistent-user lookup. Set adminToken only if an ADMIN token is available; public registration intentionally cannot create ADMIN accounts.

exec: if (adminToken) { pm.test("HTTP 404", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); }); pm.test("Error code is NOT_FOUND", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("NOT_FOUND"); }); } else { console.warn("Skipped 404 assertion: adminToken is blank."); }

item.name: 09 - Negative Payment
item.description: Creates a separate completed ride exclusively for negative payment cases. Do not substitute the happy-path rideId because it already has a PAID payment.

item.name: Verify Rejected Payments Were Not Persisted

exec: pm.test("Payment status is FAILED and never PAID", function () { pm.expect(json.paymentStatus).to.eql("FAILED"); pm.expect(json.paymentStatus).not.to.eql("PAID"); });
pm.test("Failed payment paidAt is null", function () { pm.expect(json.paidAt).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Same failed payment is retrieved", function () { pm.expect(json.paymentId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("failedPaymentId")); });
pm.test("Persisted paidAt remains null", function () { pm.expect(json.paidAt).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Error code is CONFLICT", function () { pm.expect(json.error).to.eql("CONFLICT"); });
